items.title: 52060_Eddie Barefield oral history interview
items.q: I finally ended up working out at the Paramount Studios with Georgie Stohl, you know, recording for pictures and stuff.

ctx.x: Was that a show band, the band that was coming in there?

Yeah. And they left California so I finally ended up working out at the Paramount Studios with Georgie Stohl, you know, recording for pictures and stuff. And then I did some things with Ralph Cooper when he had his studio out there. And I did a thing called "Bargain with Bullets."
